member.name: M:Maths.Information.KLDivergence.Forward(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Double},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Double},System.Double)
member.summary:
Forward KL divergence: KL(P ‖ Q) = Σᵢ pᵢ · log(pᵢ / qᵢ). Result is in nats. Always ≥ 0; equals 0 iff P = Q almost everywhere.
Explicit length guard: spans are walked in lockstep from p.Length; mismatched lengths would silently truncate rather than throw at indexing.
member.param: Floor applied to q[i] when p[i] > 0 and q[i] ≈ 0. Prevents −∞ without requiring pre-smoothed Q. For sparse text use smoothing instead.

member.name: M:Maths.Information.KLDivergence.Symmetric(System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Double},System.ReadOnlySpan{System.Double},System.Double)
member.summary: Symmetric KL (Jeffreys divergence): KL(P ‖ Q) + KL(Q ‖ P). Symmetric and always ≥ 0; equals 0 iff P = Q almost everywhere.

member.name: T:Maths.Information.IDivergence`1
member.summary:
Dispatch surface for directed divergences over a domain .
is order-sensitive: D(a ‖ b) ≠ D(b ‖ a) in general. returns a symmetrized form (default = Jeffreys-style sum); implementations override when a more efficient or canonical symmetrization exists (e.g. Jensen-Shannon's mid-distribution path).

member.name: M:Maths.Information.IDivergence`1.Symmetric(`0,`0)
member.summary: Symmetrized form. Default implementation: Forward(a,b) + Forward(b,a).
